issue_context.title: [internal] Update Modernizer tests to Safari 18
issue_context.body: Motivation: Currently our Modernizer Tests reference Safari 14, we should update them to 18 to ensure it matches feature-wise Safari 18.

review_comments: Perhaps we can update `expected` instead, now with the new version of Modernizr?
Modernizr crashes with `WebGL: context lost` and is not able to generate a report when WebGL is not available / on our macOS-13 bots. So keeping it skipped for now.
